applicable_to: IEEE Transactions and journal-style publications using the standard IEEEtran journal format.
notes:
Class is auto-fetched by Tectonic at compile time; no bundled class file needed. Citation style: IEEEtran numeric (bibtex). main.tex's macros were cross-checked against the official bare_jrnl.tex sample (Michael Shell, CTAN/michaelshell.org) to include IEEEmembership author block, running head via \markboth, IEEEPARstart drop capital, \IEEEpeerreviewmaketitle, an \appendices section, and author biography blocks. Body content is a real filled-in illustrative paper (a constant-memory streaming anomaly detector) rather than meta-instructions, so it reads like an actual paper -- not placeholder text -- and doubles as a realistic test case for the structure/vision checker. Contains 3 real matplotlib-generated figures: an F1-vs-anomaly-rate line chart and a memory bar chart in Experiments/Results, plus a synthetic sensor-trace time series in Proposed Method illustrating the detection mechanism itself before the quantitative results. IEEE_Journal_Template.pdf is a kept compiled reference render (like IEEE_Conference_Template.pdf in ieee-conference/), excluded from get_template_files like all PDFs. Verified to compile cleanly with zero Overfull/Underfull warnings.

IMPORTANT structure-checker lesson learned from a real blank-space defect found in this template: IEEEbiographynophoto reserves a FIXED photo-slot height (~1.25in) regardless of text length -- adding more bio text does NOT close the gap (tested up to 7 lines with zero change), and neither does \raggedbottom (that only fixes column-fill stretching, a different root cause). The actual fix was switching to IEEEbiography WITH an actual photo (photo1.png/photo2.png placeholders), so the reserved space holds real content instead of being empty. Separately, IEEEtran's automatic last-page column-equalization left a large gap between the two consecutive IEEEbiography blocks even after adding photos; the documented IEEEtran fix (present as commented-out guidance in the official bare_jrnl.tex itself) is inserting \newpage between them to force the second biography to the top of the next column instead of leaving a gap in the current one. Takeaway for the vision/structure-checker: blank-space fixes are not one-size-fits-all (add text / add raggedbottom / add newpage) -- diagnosing WHICH mechanism is reserving the space (a fixed-size placeholder vs. column-fill stretching vs. column-equalization) determines which fix actually applies, and the wrong fix will compile clean with zero warnings while still looking visibly broken.
